sentences.zh: 我给《名利场》拍过一组照片，他们说我可以扮演电影里的任何角色，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: And I went as Harrison Ford from Star Wars.
sentences.zh: 于是我就扮成了《星球大战》里的哈里森·福特。

sentences.en: Speaking of that, speaking of that, you must know, Mark, that these guys know Scotty, my husband, is as big a fan as I am.
sentences.zh: 说到这个，马克，你得知道，这些家伙都知道我丈夫斯科蒂和我一样，是你的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: I mean, we've, you know, we're just massive.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们，你知道，我们简直是铁杆粉丝。

sentences.zh: 他扮成了凯洛·伦。

sentences.zh: 他扮成了凯洛·伦。

sentences.zh: 我是说，没有比这更宅的了。

sentences.en: We've got Scotty and the Kylo Ren.
sentences.zh: 我们有斯科蒂和凯洛·伦。

sentences.en: And more royalties for George Lucas.
sentences.zh: 又给乔治·卢卡斯贡献了一笔版权费。

sentences.en: He's got the lightsaber.
sentences.zh: 他连光剑都带了。

sentences.en: So Scotty's got, like, a couple.
sentences.zh: 所以斯科蒂准备了好几套。

sentences.en: Hi, Scott.
sentences.zh: 嗨，斯科特。

sentences.en: He's been waiting.
sentences.zh: 他已经等很久了。

sentences.en: I've been sitting here for like an hour.
sentences.zh: 我都在这儿坐了一个小时了。

sentences.en: You know, my mom told me, she said, when you were born, I couldn't decide on a name.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我妈跟我说过，她说我出生的时候，她定不下名字。

sentences.en: It was between Mark and Scott.
sentences.zh: 在马克和斯科特之间犹豫不决。

sentences.en: And they said, if you don't decide right now, we're just going to put baby Hamill on the birth certificate.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果你现在不决定，我们就直接在出生证明上写“哈米尔宝宝”了。

sentences.en: So she literally flipped a coin.
sentences.zh: 所以她真的抛硬币决定了。

sentences.en: And, of course, when she tells you that at age seven, you go, oh, Scott's so much a cooler name.
sentences.zh: 当然，当你七岁时听到这个，你会觉得，哦，斯科特这个名字酷多了。

sentences.en: You should have named him Scott.
sentences.zh: 你应该叫他斯科特的。

sentences.en: You always want what you don't have, right?
sentences.zh: 人总是想要自己没有的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: But Scott, I'm a big fan, but Scotty's like a mega, mega fan.
sentences.zh: 不过斯科特，我是你的大粉丝，但斯科蒂是那种超级、超级粉丝。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.zh: 来吧，斯科蒂。

sentences.en: And he's got a couple questions.
sentences.zh: 他有几个问题要问。

sentences.en: It's next level.
sentences.zh: 这可是顶级粉丝了。

sentences.en: Hang on.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: Hang on.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: First of all, welcome to SmartList, Scotty.
sentences.zh: 首先，欢迎来到《SmartLess》，斯科蒂。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think this is Scotty's debut, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 没错，我想这是斯科蒂的首次亮相，对吧？

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm not in the background, but that's a good one.
sentences.zh: 我没在背景里，但这个梗不错。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: Mark, it's such an honor to meet you.
sentences.zh: 马克，见到你真是太荣幸了。

sentences.en: I mean, it goes without saying, as such a huge fan I am.
sentences.zh: 我是说，作为你的超级粉丝，这不用说我也知道。

sentences.en: But I think my question really is, at what point when everything was done, the film was done, it was completed, and it was about to come out and all of that?
sentences.zh: 但我想问的问题是，当一切都结束了，电影拍完了，制作完成了，快要上映的时候，在那一刻？

sentences.en: I know the typical question is, did you know it was going to be a hit?
sentences.zh: 我知道通常大家都会问，你当时知道它会火吗？

sentences.en: Of course, nobody knows it's going to be a hit.
sentences.zh: 当然，没人知道它会成为热门作品。

sentences.en: Anything's going to be a hit.
sentences.zh: 任何作品都有可能成为热门。

sentences.en: It just, it's not up to us.
sentences.zh: 这只是……这不由我们决定。

sentences.en: But when did you have that visceral sort of reaction like we all had, or did you ever have it like audiences had, where you realized, oh, this is something bigger than all of us.
sentences.zh: 但你是什么时候产生那种像我们所有人一样的本能反应的？或者说，你是否曾像观众那样，意识到“噢，这东西比我们所有人都伟大”？

sentences.en: This is unreal.
sentences.zh: 这太不真实了。

sentences.en: There was a moment, and it was, we, they sent the three of us, Carrie Harrison and me, to promote it.
sentences.zh: 确实有那么一刻，当时他们派我们三个——凯莉、哈里森和我——去宣传这部电影。

sentences.en: And we did Vancouver.
sentences.zh: 我们去了温哥华。

sentences.en: I don't think it had opened, and then it opened, and when we came into Chicago, I looked outside the plane, and I saw massive crowds.
sentences.zh: 我想当时电影还没上映，后来上映了。当我们抵达芝加哥时，我看向飞机窗外，看到了乌泱泱的人群。

sentences.en: And I said, hey, you guys, there's somebody famous on this plane.
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，伙计们，这飞机上肯定有哪位大人物。

sentences.en: We were looking around to see if, like, there was a big sports star or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我们四处张望，想看看是不是有什么体育明星之类的。

sentences.en: And then as we got closer, I said, hey, Carrie, look, that girl has buns on.
sentences.zh: 等我们靠近了，我说，嘿，凯莉，看，那个女孩梳着发髻。

sentences.en: She's got the Princess Leigh bun.
sentences.zh: 她梳着莱娅公主的发髻。

sentences.en: Harrison, that guy's got the vest and everything.
sentences.zh: 哈里森，那个家伙穿着背心，装备齐全。

sentences.en: Somebody had made a Luke tunic out of a pillow, because there were people dressed like us.
sentences.zh: 还有人拿枕头做了卢克的束腰外衣，因为当时到处都是打扮成我们角色的人。

sentences.en: And we all looked at each other like, whoa, that's above and beyond.
sentences.zh: 我们面面相觑，心想，哇，这真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: I mean, you want it to be a successful movie, but when you see people then role-playing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你当然希望电影成功，但当你看到人们开始角色扮演时……

sentences.en: Yeah, especially 50 years later, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，尤其是50年后，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it's like, hey, like a grown man.
sentences.zh: 我是说，就像，嘿，一个成年男人。

sentences.en: Go ahead, next question, Scotty.
sentences.zh: 继续吧，下一个问题，斯科蒂。

sentences.en: Listen, I'm here to give Sean a break from the harassment.
sentences.zh: 听着，我是来帮肖恩挡挡这些“骚扰”的。

sentences.en: It's now for me.
sentences.zh: 现在轮到我了。

sentences.en: Well, listen, I have to tell you, it's a double-edged sword, because what will happen is,
sentences.zh: 好吧，听着，我得告诉你，这是一把双刃剑，因为会发生这样的事——

sentences.en: and this has been happening for 20, 30 years, the kids that were little when it came out
sentences.zh: 这种情况已经持续了二三十年了，那些电影上映时还是小孩子的人，

sentences.en: are now parents of their own, and you'll be in an airport or something.
sentences.zh: 现在都已经为人父母了，你会在机场之类的地方遇到他们。

sentences.en: And, you know, a five- or six-year-old, they think we made Star Wars two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 你知道，五六岁的孩子，他们以为我们是两周前才拍的《星球大战》。

sentences.en: I mean, there's nothing to really date it in terms of models of cars or clothing or whatever.
sentences.zh: 毕竟电影里没什么能体现时代的东西，比如汽车模型、服装之类的。

sentences.en: So they have no concept of time, and so they'll be, you know, the parents will gesture to a 55-year-old
sentences.zh: 所以他们对时间没有概念，于是父母会指着55岁的我，

sentences.en: me and go, hey, kids, look who it is.
sentences.zh: 对孩子说，嘿，孩子们，看那是谁。

sentences.en: It's Luke Skywalker, and they look at this, look at me in horror.
sentences.zh: 那是卢克·天行者，然后他们看着我，眼神里充满了惊恐。

sentences.en: Like, God, what happened to this guy?
sentences.zh: 就像是，天哪，这家伙怎么变成这样了？

sentences.en: He really let himself know.
sentences.zh: 他真的太放纵自己了。

sentences.en: Great makeup artist in the movie.
sentences.zh: 电影里的化妆师很棒。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实。

sentences.en: So, wait, so, Scotty, do you have another question before you take off?
sentences.zh: 等等，斯科蒂，在你走之前还有别的问题吗？

sentences.en: Oh, Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: No, I didn't realize I'd be...
sentences.zh: 不，我没意识到我会……

sentences.en: No, you can hang out.
sentences.zh: 不，你可以留下来。

sentences.en: I didn't know if you wanted to.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是不是想走。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: No, I would love to.
sentences.zh: 不，我很乐意留下。

sentences.en: Oh, hang on, hang on, hang on, hang on, hang on one second.
sentences.zh: 噢，等等，等等，等等，等等，等一下。

sentences.en: Let me just say, Scotty, Scotty, I don't think that Sean meant that.
sentences.zh: 让我说一句，斯科蒂，斯科蒂，我觉得肖恩不是那个意思。

sentences.en: I think that what he meant to say, like, he didn't know if you had more.
sentences.zh: 我想他想表达的是，他不知道你还有没有别的问题。

sentences.en: Sean, I got this.
sentences.zh: 肖恩，这事儿我来处理。

sentences.en: And then, Sean, Sean, look at Scotty and tell him what you meant to say.
sentences.zh: 然后，肖恩，肖恩，看着斯科蒂，告诉他你原本想说什么。

sentences.en: Well, what I meant to say was, I didn't know if you had to go somewhere, and I didn't want to keep you on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想说的是，我不知道你是不是有别的事要忙，不想一直把你困在播客里。

sentences.en: Where the fuck does he have to go?
sentences.zh: 他妈的他能有什么事要忙？

sentences.en: Be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话。

sentences.en: I mean, what are you talking?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你在说什么呢？

sentences.en: This is great.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: And now, Scott, how are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 那么现在，斯科特，你感觉如何？

sentences.en: No, no, look at Sean, and you tell him how you're feeling.
sentences.zh: 不，不，看着肖恩，告诉他你现在的感觉。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm feeling wonderful, and thank you for the opportunity, and it's a pleasure to be here, and I-
sentences.zh: 噢，我感觉棒极了，感谢给我这个机会，能来到这里真是我的荣幸，而且我——

sentences.en: Well, our hour is up.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们的时间到了。

sentences.en: I'm glad that Mark could be here for the two of the biggest Star Wars fans in the world, that, Mark, you could see them work out.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴马克能来到这里，见证世界上两位最大的《星球大战》粉丝，马克，你能看到他们解决问题。

sentences.en: In couples therapy.
sentences.zh: 在夫妻治疗中。

sentences.en: In couples therapy.
sentences.zh: 在夫妻治疗中。

sentences.en: We owe everything to the fans.
sentences.zh: 我们的一切都归功于粉丝们。

sentences.en: If it weren't for them, we wouldn't be anywhere.
sentences.zh: 如果不是因为他们，我们什么都不是。

sentences.en: Right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: Look at that.
sentences.zh: 你看那个。

sentences.en: Wait, Scotty, you have to have one last Burning Desire question.
sentences.zh: 等等，斯科蒂，你还得问最后一个“燃烧的欲望”问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, something.
sentences.zh: 对，随便什么都行。

sentences.en: What about Norway with the Empire Strikes Back and the snow?
sentences.zh: 关于挪威拍摄《帝国反击战》时的大雪怎么样？

sentences.en: Remember we were talking about that?
sentences.zh: 还记得我们之前聊过这个吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，记得，记得，记得。

sentences.en: Wasn't there, I could have this wrong, but wasn't there a thing where you guys were, you know, where you were in Norway, it was just absolutely treacherous with all the snow.
sentences.zh: 是不是有这么回事——我可能记错了——你们当时在挪威，那里的积雪简直险象环生。

sentences.en: And I think you guys were scheduled to go shoot somewhere or whatever it was, but it was so bad, then you just went out the back door and did stuff?
sentences.zh: 我记得你们本来计划去某个地方拍摄之类的，但天气太糟糕了，所以你们就从后门出去直接拍了？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Here's what happened.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: And they, you know, our luck was terrible.
sentences.zh: 我们的运气真是糟透了。

sentences.en: We had rainstorms in Tunisia that cost us, we had to shut down.
sentences.zh: 我们在突尼斯遇到了暴雨，不得不停工。

sentences.en: Then we go to Norway, it was like the coldest winter in, I don't know, 11 billion years, whatever it was.
sentences.zh: 然后我们去了挪威，那是——我不知道——110亿年来最冷的冬天，反正就是冷得要命。

sentences.en: And they had found a glacier, which was about an hour and a half from where we were staying.
sentences.zh: 他们找了一座冰川，离我们住的地方大约有一个半小时的路程。

sentences.en: And we would take, we were meant to go on snow buggies because it photographed on camera, it photographed blue.
sentences.zh: 我们本该乘坐雪地车过去，因为那样拍出来的画面是蓝色的。

sentences.en: And I remember now, this is the days before a lot of CGI, everything was practical in those days.
sentences.zh: 我记得那时候还没有那么多CGI，所有东西都是实景拍摄。

sentences.en: So the day arrives for us to go to this blue glacier and they said, it's impossible.
sentences.zh: 结果到了要去那座蓝色冰川的那天，他们说，根本不可能。

sentences.en: I mean, even if we go there, it'll be whited out from the blizzard.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就算我们去了，暴风雪也会让画面白茫茫一片。

sentences.en: So like you say, it was Han Solo rescuing Luke in the snow after getting hit by the wampa.
sentences.zh: 所以就像你说的，那场戏是韩·索罗在雪地里救出被雪怪袭击后的卢克。

sentences.en: And if you turn the camera around, there's people on the balcony sipping cocoa watching us.
sentences.zh: 如果你把镜头转过去，就能看到阳台上有人在喝着可可看我们拍戏。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，哇。

sentences.en: We're about a hundred yards from the back of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 我们离酒店后门也就一百码远。

sentences.en: That's crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: This is where you cut the belly open on the thing and you got inside?
sentences.zh: 所以那就是你们剖开那东西的肚子钻进去的地方？

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 不会吧。

sentences.en: That is crazy.
sentences.zh: 那真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: So I mean, they were all enjoying it, but it's funny now because, you know, in those days, there wasn't so much security.
sentences.zh: 所以，大家当时都看得挺乐呵，但现在回想起来很有趣，因为那时候安保还没那么严。

sentences.en: In other words, when I read Star Wars, I just blew my mind and I said, oh my God, I've got to get my friend Jonathan to read this.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，当我读到《星球大战》剧本时，我简直惊呆了，我说，天哪，我一定要让我朋友乔纳森也读读这个。

sentences.en: So my best friend Jonathan worked down at the LA Art Museum and I passed it to him and he read it.
sentences.zh: 所以我最好的朋友乔纳森当时在洛杉矶艺术博物馆工作，我把剧本传给了他，他读了。

sentences.en: He said, yeah, I don't know how they're going to do this or what it is really.
sentences.zh: 他说，是啊，我不知道他们打算怎么拍，或者这到底是什么。

sentences.en: He goes, can I give it to Meredith?
sentences.zh: 他说，我可以给梅雷迪思看吗？

sentences.en: I said, yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 我说，行，当然可以。

sentences.en: So we passed it all around.
sentences.zh: 于是我们就这样传阅开了。

sentences.en: All my friends read it.
sentences.zh: 我所有的朋友都读了。

sentences.en: It was before everything was coded with your name on it.
sentences.zh: 那是在一切文件都还没加上名字水印之前。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Where you have to protect it with your life.
sentences.zh: 那时候还没到需要用生命去保护剧本的程度。

sentences.en: But it was just a different time.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个不同的时代。

sentences.en: And like I say, I had a blaSt.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我玩得很开心。

sentences.en: I mean, one thing that hit me, I said, you know what I love about this is you can take from it what you want.
sentences.zh: 有一点触动了我，我说，你知道我喜欢这部作品的哪一点吗？就是你可以从中汲取你想要的东西。

sentences.en: In other words, it's effortlessly feminiSt.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，她毫不费力地展现了女性特质。

sentences.en: The princess is anything but a shrinking violet.
sentences.zh: 这位公主绝非那种唯唯诺诺的弱女子。

sentences.en: She takes over her own rescue, makes Han and Luke look like a couple of chumps.
sentences.zh: 她亲自掌控了自己的营救行动，让汉和卢克看起来像两个笨蛋。

sentences.en: You call it as a rescue, give me that gun.
sentences.zh: 你管这叫营救？把枪给我。

sentences.en: And she's standing up to Vader, nose to nose, and, you know, really giving him.
sentences.zh: 她敢于直面维达，针锋相对，你知道，真的让他吃尽了苦头。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so what I'm saying is that is just accepted and it's.
